name: frag
description: Fragment Retrieval and Generation. Searches local repository hubs first, with GitHub/Gitea fallback, and returns the smallest set of code fragments relevant to a symptom report.

repo_hub.title: Local repository hub
repo_hub.description: Optional repository hub root. FRAG auto-detects /srv/repos when this is blank. Expected subdirectories include github/, gitea/, mirrors/, and archive/.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: PAT with repo:read for GitHub repositories that are not available from the local hub.

github_default_owner.title: GitHub default owner
github_default_owner.description: Owner assumed when a reference omits it and local clone metadata cannot supply it.

gitea_url.title: Gitea URL
gitea_url.description: Base URL of your Gitea instance, used for remote fallback and local mirror identity checking.

gitea_token.title: Gitea token
gitea_token.description: Gitea access token used only when remote fallback is needed.

gitea_default_owner.title: Gitea default owner
gitea_default_owner.description: Owner assumed when a Gitea reference omits it and local metadata cannot supply it.
